votes.reason: A fortress bank at 16.4x trailing earnings, with EPS up 13.4% and the lowest weekly volatility on the sheet (1.57%), is cheap and sound, which is why I picked it.
At 23.7x trailing it is not a bargain, but 14.7% EPS growth from a sound, cash-generative staple earns that multiple, so my lens gives no concrete reason against it.

At 29.9x trailing after an 18.15% 12-week run it has the highest multiple on the sheet, but 14.1% EPS growth from a capital-light payments network makes that a full price for a sound business, not a reason to object.

Trailing EPS fell 26.1% yet the stock still trades at 21.1x, a higher multiple than JPM or REGN, so my table shows neither a cheap price nor sound earnings, and the case depends on a recovery the numbers do not yet show.

At 16.9x trailing with EPS still growing (3.0%), it is the cheaper of the book's two healthcare names and my own pick, and its 5.18% weekly volatility is already reflected in the smallest weight in the book.
